quotes_used_verbatim: All shipboard expenses are charged to your Onboard account. Sign up when you check in, establishing your method of payment with Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, JCB Card, Diner's Club.
Once you have exceeded the deposited amount, your account will be closed to further charges.
Refunds cannot be made until the day of disembarkation for any excess.
primary_sources.figures_used: Cash deposit guidance: 7-day $300 USD per person; less than 7 days $150 USD per person; more than 7 days $450 USD per person. Quoted as NCL's published guidance with the read date stated in the article text.

claims.lived_anchor: The $16 pending credit and $2.75 pending charge, the card closing mid-meal in a specialty restaurant, roughly an hour to eat and another hour trying to resolve the bill, and the collision with the luggage window and a show - all from the published Norwegian Getaway Aug 24-28 2026 logbook on this site.
claims.explicitly_flagged_as_observation_not_po: The claim that the beverage package was the first privilege to stop working is printed as what we observed on ONE sailing, with an explicit statement that no policy document establishing an order of precedence was found and an invitation to be corrected.
claims.card_hold_behaviour: The incremental-holds-on-cards contrast is described generically from NCL's own published description of card pre-authorisation behaviour; no specific hold amount or duration figure is asserted in the article body.
claims.not_claimed: No claim about other cruise lines' cash-account thresholds or ceiling behaviour - the article states explicitly these were not verified line by line. No claim about how often this happens, no averages, no claim about NCL's internal systems or intent.
